summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 12, 2026, solely to furnish its updated Articles of Association (Exhibit 3.1 dated August 11, 2026). The filing is routine governance documentation and contains no special-situation event. The Articles cover standard items such as share capital (DKK 62,377,844), board authorizations to issue shares and warrants, and general corporate matters. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital-return activities disclosed. The submission is a routine foreign private issuer report, so no strategic implications or deal terms exist. What to watch: none; this is a housekeeping filing with no risk-arb angle.
